objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object representing a policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Short code identifying the document type (e.g. RL for guideline), combined with a consecutive number.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid indicating strategic vs. operational scope.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number tracking revisions of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version of the document is considered valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus the validity period.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable time period for validity review cycle, default 3 years per document type.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable retention period for archived documents before physical deletion, default 10 years.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Applicable scope or areas of validity for the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents, master data, or related objects.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Referenced IT applications associated with the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or organizational entities to which the document applies.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Specific areas or regions where the document is applicable.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Person registered as the primary author responsible for creating and signing the document.

attributes.name: co_authors
attributes.description: Additional persons with write permissions on the document who can initiate the release process.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person(s) assigned to check the document for technical and formal correctness.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person(s) responsible for final approval and release of the document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group assignment controlling which readers may view the document.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute controlling email notification distribution upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute controlling acknowledgement-based distribution upon release.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specification of which clients in a multi-client system can see the document.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document attached to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document's release cycle.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment within the main document's release process.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary information object attached to a document that is not subject to the main document's release cycle and can be published directly via property switches.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Published or unpublished status of the additional information.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal for changes to an existing released document, created by any author without affecting the document's content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Details of the proposed change to the document.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend, revise, or invalidate the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the validity extension request.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a document and archive it, triggering the out-of-force process and withdrawal of authorizations.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the override request.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document, restoring its validity and authorizations.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the reactivation request.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new documents, supporting TAG technology for automatic metadata insertion.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used to assign read, write, acknowledgement, and distribution authorizations for documents.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Classification of the user group (e.g. Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive, Business Admin).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and individual persons assigned to a document for email notification or acknowledgement distribution upon release.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A recorded signature from a workflow participant documenting their completion of a workflow step, stored per released version.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: The person who provided the electronic signature.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the signature was recorded.

attributes.name: workflow_step
attributes.description: The step in the release process where the signature was provided (e.g. Creator, Review, Release).

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A confirmation record from a user acknowledging receipt and review of a released document version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Whether the acknowledgement has been confirmed or is still pending.

attributes.name: person
attributes.description: The user who is required to or has confirmed acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process controlling the release, validity extension, override, or reactivation of documents through defined steps and participants.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (e.g. release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement, translation release).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the workflow execution.

objs.name: translation
objs.description: A language-dependent version of a released document that must go through its own review and release workflow before becoming visible to readers.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Target language of the translated document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the translation (e.g. in progress, released).

attributes.name: reviewer_translation
attributes.description: Person assigned to review the translated version.

attributes.name: releaser_translation
attributes.description: Person assigned to release the translated version.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity within the company structure that can be linked to documents.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process that can be linked to documents and used for process-specific filing.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: A master data object representing an IT application that can be referenced by documents.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A risk object that can be linked to documents as part of master data relationships.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A tenant or organizational unit in a multi-client system where documents can be made visible or restricted.
